author: Krono I
title: Attention-Based CNN-LSTM with Baseline PG Algorithm
abstract: This submission pivots from algorithmic improvements back to architecture. Previous PPO experiments (ID 9, 18, 19, 31) failed due to computational inefficiency and timeouts. This experiment uses the proven, time-efficient baseline Policy Gradient algorithm and pairs it with a new Attention-based CNN-LSTM architecture. The hypothesis is that a more sophisticated network, capable of focusing on relevant spatial features, will outperform the standard CNN-LSTM baseline when trained with an efficient algorithm.

original_submission.content:
import sys
from ray import tune

# Add my lineage storage to the path to import the new architecture
sys.path.append('storage/krono')
from attention_network import AttentionCNNLSTM

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define search space, adding the new attention_heads parameter."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'lstm_features': tune.choice([256]),
        'attention_heads': tune.choice([4]) # New hyperparameter for the attention layer
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    """Create the new AttentionCNNLSTM network."""
    return AttentionCNNLSTM(
        lstm_features=int(hparams['lstm_features']),
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        attention_heads=int(hparams['attention_heads'])
    )

# No training_step or create_optimizer is defined, so the system will
# use the efficient default Policy Gradient implementation.

BASE_SEED = 78901
